method: Python random.Random(seed).choice over independently authored five scene options
options: an overnight planetarium projectionist aligning a brass star projector
a conservatory archivist inspecting a glass orchid bell jar
a miniature theater technician winding a mechanical moon
a radio astronomer tuning an analog receiver in a dish control room
a museum horologist restarting an astronomical clock
selected: an overnight planetarium projectionist aligning a brass star projector

independent_interpretations.Cross-Color Lighting: Differently colored directional lights meet across the same subject.
independent_interpretations.Colored Rim Light: Narrow colored back illumination follows hair and shoulder contour.
independent_interpretations.Background Color Wash: Broad colored light illuminates a background surface.
